name: Dona Rita
summary: Minimal one-pager for a Brazilian cheese bread bakery, kept on One Page Love as a screenshot and an archive link.
description: One Page Love award entry for Dona Rita, a minimal bakery one-pager by Pedro Duarte promoting Brazilian cheese bread with only four images across the whole site. Flat-design, whitespace-heavy layout with a page border and a typewriter effect. The live site has been redesigned or gone offline, so the entry keeps the screenshot and links to an Archive.org copy.
